messages:
maya (PM): quick async Q2 check — need a short status update from owners. TL;DR: runtime perf flags rolled out to canary (liam), model-onboarding slipped ~2w (adrian), rollout infra gating on capacity (sophie). please reply with: shipped/slipped, blocker, ETA, any cr/review pings.

liam (Eng): runtime v2 canary deployed to 10% yesterday. observed ~12% median latency reduction on gen-100 token tests. one flaky e2e failure on streaming client (looks like timeout on reconnect). investigating root cause. status: shipped->canary. blocker: repro for e2e. ETA on fix: ~48h. @sophie can you confirm canary capacity for bump to 40% next week?

sophie (Eng-Platform): can confirm extra slot for canary bump if we freeze other non-urgent jobs. I can free up 2 GPUs by Tues EOD. also need infra team to approve burst policy change (ticket #INF-421). status: gated -> waiting infra approval.

adrian (Eng-ML): model-onboarding slipped — found a schema mismatch between customer metadata and our fine-tune manifest, which required rework of preprocessing. patch is ready and tests pass locally, but we need a reviewer and a small infra change to allow larger batch loads during import. status: slipped ~2w. blocker: review + import concurrency flag. ETA if reviewer available: 3 business days.

noah (Product): I can review adrian's PR tomorrow AM. please drop repro or short checklist in the PR description so I can go fast. also inventory: which customers are impacted by the onboarding slip? we should surface to CS.

adrian (Eng-ML): thanks @noah — impacted: 3 pilots (Acme, BrightHealth, NovaPay). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-onboard/pull/572 — minimal repro below.

adrian (Eng-ML): ```python
# repro snippet for manifest mismatch
from onboarding import validate_manifest
manifest = {'id': 'cust-01', 'records': [{'text': 'hi', 'meta': {'tags': ['x']}}]}
validate_manifest(manifest)  # raises KeyError on 'annotations'
```

liam (Eng): I'll take a quick look at the PR after dinner. if it's just safe mapping defaults we can merge with a follow-up regression test. also +1 on surfacing impacted pilots to CS.

sophie (Eng-Platform): infra ticket updated: INF-421 -> approves burst policy, pending security sign-off (sec-ops). I can escalate. if we get sign-off today we can bump canary on Wed.

maya (PM): action list (from thread): 1) @liam finish e2e repro + fix (48h). 2) @adrian add PR checklist + notify CS (noah to confirm comms). 3) @sophie escalate INF-421 to sec-ops; free 2 GPUs Tue EOD. owners, ack these and add any small TODOs inline. trying to avoid scheduling a meeting — keep async. :thumbsup:

noah (Product): ack. I'll draft a short message for CS and send to maya for sign-off.

liam (Eng): ack. I'll post repro in the issue and leave a status update.

adrian (Eng-ML): ack — will add checklist, attach failing sample and request reviewer @liam/@noah.

deploy-bot: deploy/2026-03-17T18:12:01Z started: canary/runtime-v2 -> 10% (sha: d4c3f2).

sophie (Eng-Platform): noted. escalating INF-421 now.

maya (PM): perfect — i'll close out once CS message is posted and e2e fix is in. thanks all for quick async responses.
